values.value: four constructs share one health pool (79920 Shared Health, aura 300 SHARE_DAMAGE_PCT 100 to the other three entries by conditions); at most two are active
values.native_derivation: ceil(gt_npc_total_hp_exp3[88].Rogue 85892 * HealthModifier 300 * HealthModifierExtra 1); unit_class 4, HealthScalingExpansion 3, rank 1, elite HP rate 1
values.status: native_value_known; guide 32.2M conflicts; WCL derivation blocked (shared_health_10n_wcl_derivation)
values.notes: Magmaw's guide 10N HP was also superseded by WCL-derived HP that matched native exactly; do not change HealthModifier from the guide.

values.value: controller shuffles all four construct GUIDs per encounter and activates them round-robin
values.notes: Do not encode a fixed first construct. The next construct is observable: it carries a Recharging aura (78697-78700 / 95019-95030) with an expiry.

values.value: Activated (78740/95016-95018) lasts 90 s normal / 60 s heroic; Recharging (78697-78700) lasts 45 s normal / 30 s heroic and starts when the previous construct activates, so two constructs overlap; expiry casts Shutting Down (78746, 3 s cast) then Inactive (78726: stun, school immunity) and Powered Down (82265)
conflicts: Wowhead describes 60 s / 30 s (heroic durations) without a mode; client and DBM give 90/45 on normal.
values.repository_observation: Native controller casts Controller Recharge (45/30 s aura) on the next construct at each activation; matches.

values.value: Unstable Shield 79900, Barrier 79582, Poison Soaked Shell 79835 and Power Conversion 79729 are 1.5 s casts with 10 s auras, once per activation
values.repository_observation: Electron/Magmatron/Arcanotron 50/40 s matched; Toxitron used 40/30 s and was fixed to 50/40 s in round 2.
conflicts: Icy Veins ties the shield to 50 energy; with a 90 s drain that is 45 s, DBM measures 50 s. Bots gate on the observed shield cast/aura, not on a timer.

values.tactic: Tanks keep constructs out (construct bounding radius 3.56 yd, so a construct is inside at ~8.6 yd); ranged and healers stand in it.

conflicts: Wowhead: jumps deal the same damage (tooltip wrong). Icy Veins: damage increases with each bounce. Native script intends +20% but applies nothing.
